note: AI translation via the keyless parallel-subagent pipeline (engine glossary + Reina-Valera 1858 supplied as authoritative scripture). Explicitly-cited verses (listed below) were rendered in the supplied Reina-Valera wording (mined). Spurgeon also weaves many verses into his prose without an explicit Book C:V citation; those were rendered by the model in RV-consistent wording (self_rendered) and are not individually enumerated. Every scripture rendering should be checked by a native reviewer. NOTE for review: a few chapters modernized the RV’s archaic vowel-accents (á→a) inside quotations while others kept them; meaning is unchanged. Doctrinal cruxes where the RV reading diverges from Spurgeon’s KJV argument were kept faithful to the author (ch08 “el trigo principal”; ch16 Amós 2:13 passive “oprimido”).
